# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version and the current
development version on `main`.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's private
vulnerability reporting feature for this repository. Do not open a public issue
or include credentials, API tokens, or other sensitive data in a pull request.

Include the affected version, a description of the impact, reproduction steps,
and any suggested mitigation. Reports will be acknowledged as soon as
practical, and fixes will be coordinated through a private security advisory.
